p: Aha: Because you rejoiced when the enemy destroyed my city and temple.
men of the east for a: That is, to the Babylonians.
palaces in thee: They will chase you away, and take your gorgeous houses to dwell in.
Rabbah a stable for camels: Called also Philadelphin, which was the chief city of the Ammonites and full of conveniences, 2Sa 12:27.
from his cities which are on: So that no power or strength should be able to resist the Babylonians.
Cherethims: Which were certain garrisons of Philistines by which they often molested the Jews, of the Cherethims David also had a guard, 2Sa 8:18.
